_meanings:
The brother of a kingʼs concubine, the brother-in-law of
 a king by a wife not regularly married ({#anUQABrAtf#}); (he is usually
 represented as a strange mixture of pride, folly, and vanity, of low family,
 and raised to power by reason of his relation to the king. In the Mṛchchhakaṭika
 of Śūdraka where he plays a prominent part, his character is well exhibited
 in his lightness and frivolity of spirit, vain-glory, constant reference
 to his high connection, his blundering and ludicrous folly, but withal
 cruelty enough to throttle the heroine when she refused to yield to his
 desire; <ls>S. D.</ls> thus defines him:-- {#madamUrKatABimAnI duzkulatESvaryasaMyuktaH .#}
 {#so'yamanUQABrAtA rAjYaH SyAlaH SakAra ityuktaH ..#}) <ls n="S. D.">81</ls>.
